// @path: src/app/actions/somewhere.ts
// @expect: contains
// The near miss the sanitiser invites: the right SHAPE, with the call left off.
// A template literal looks deliberate and reads as though somebody thought about
// it, which is exactly why it must not pass on its appearance.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function wordPrefix(query: string) {
  return db.establishment.findMany({ where: { name: { contains: ` ${query}` } } });
}
